name: reveal
description: A hidden entity here becomes known to the player.

entity_id.description: Exact id of something hidden here.
Exact id of who here died.

name: join_party
description: A character here starts travelling with the player.

entity_id.description: Exact id of who is joining.

name: leave_party
description: A party member stops travelling with the player.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the party member leaving.

name: hire
description: Call this when the player hires someone here to work. Someone already travelling with the player can be hired too. The worldsmith writes their sheet once the turn ends. Nothing more lands this turn. A sheet is for someone hired to work, never for one who only comes along.

entity_id.description: Exact id of who here signs on.

terms.description: What they are hired for, and on what terms, as agreed.

name: enter
description: A cast member comes into the scene.

entity_id.description: Exact id of a cast member not already here.

name: leave
description: A cast member goes out of the scene.

name: next_scene
description: Call this with nothing set when the scene reaches a stopping point. Set `pursuit` instead once the player has left this place. Set `complication` instead to bring a new situation down on this place.

pursuit.description: Where the player is going, in their own words. Empty to offer the way on.

complication.description: What arrives or turns here, and why. Empty otherwise.

name: change_hindrances
description: The actor picks up hindrances, sheds them, or both at once.

lost.description: Hindrances the actor no longer carries.

actor_id.description: Exact id of a hired party member here who acts. Null for the player.

name: gain_item
description: The actor gains an item and pays for it.

bulky.description: True when the item takes real space to carry.

breaks.description: How many times the item can break before it is ruined.

cost.description: Credits paid. 0 for a thing found or given.

actor_id.description: Exact id of a hired party member here who acts. Null for the player.

name: drop_item
description: The actor loses an item for good.

item_id.description: Exact id of an item the actor carries.

actor_id.description: Exact id of a hired party member here who acts. Null for the player.

name: repair_item
description: The actor mends a broken item.

item_id.description: Exact id of an item the actor carries, or a ship function.

actor_id.description: Exact id of a hired party member here who acts. Null for the player.

name: spend
description: The actor pays credits for something that is not an item or a repair.

why.description: What the credits pay for, in a few words.

actor_id.description: Exact id of a hired party member here who acts. Null for the player.

name: take_lead
description: A hired member takes the lead after the player dies.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the living hired member who takes the lead.

name: ship_upgrade
description: The player upgrades one ship function.

function_id.description: Exact id of a ship function. The player pays ₡10.

name: defend
description: A carried item or a ship function breaks so a hit becomes a hindrance.

item_id.description: Exact id of an item the actor carries, or a ship function.

hindrance.description: What the harm becomes, as a hindrance. Empty for an item that breaks harmlessly.

actor_id.description: Exact id of a hired party member here who acts. Null for the player.

name: roll
description: Call this when the outcome of an action matters. The engine picks the dice, rolls them, and reads the result.

what.description: The attempt, in a few words the player reads.

actor_id.description: Exact id of a hired party member here who acts. Null for the player.

skill.description: Which skill to roll. Empty rolls the plain d6.

helped.description: Why circumstances help. Empty when none do.

helped_by.description: Exact id of a hired member who rolls their own die. Null when none helps.

hindered.description: Why the actor is hindered. Empty when none is.

risking_death.description: True when the actor risks death on this roll.

name: test_luck
description: Call this to ask about the world's bad luck when nobody acts. The engine rolls one d6 and reads it.

question.description: A closed question about the world where nobody is acting.

name: job
description: Call this to look for work with `find`, to record agreed work with `take`, and to close the job with `finish`. With `find` the engine rolls the SRD's d6. With `finish` it raises one skill for each operator and pays each of them d6 credits.

verb.description: `find` looks for work. `take` records agreed work. `finish` closes the job.

where.description: Where the player looks for work, in a few words. Required with `find`.

terms.description: Who wants what done, what that looks like, and what it pays. Required with `take`.

raises.description: One per operator: the player and every living hired member. Required with `finish`.

actor_id.description: Exact id of a hired party member here who acts. Null for the player.

skill.description: The skill the job called on for them.
